utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — Sunday at the community center works. If you can, please bring the rest of the repair stuff by then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — I’ll bring the rest of the repair stuff to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, Oren — thanks for handling that.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Sunday at the community center — got it. I’ll keep an eye on the parking, timing, and the tool list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that helps a lot. I’m still a bit worried about parking and getting everything moved over to the community center on time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll keep checking both the parking and the timing, and I’ll watch for any missing tools too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate you checking. Just let me know what they still need when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ll check what they still need and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it. I’ll wait to hear back from you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep waiting for your update and hold onto the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m back with the latest drop-off details, Hana — here’s everything I picked up so you can keep the repair drive info straight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ve got it, and I’ll keep waiting for your next update.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, because with it moved to Sunday at the community center, people need the updated place and parking info.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, Sunday at the community center — I’ll keep repeating the place and parking plan so everyone stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that should help a lot — I just want to make sure everyone gets the new Sunday location and parking details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on for around 3 today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not today — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep track of the Sunday community center location and sort whatever comes in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word that it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send any sorting your way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Quinn — I’ll keep everything organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now—let’s start with the donations by the garage, then I’ll check the repair kits with you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Dane — that’s the right order. I’ll keep the donations ready by the garage, and we can check the repair kits right after.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll head to the garage now and start sorting the donations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Gus — just let me know when it’s locked in, and I’ll keep the afternoon clear.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Faye — I’ll let you know as soon as the time’s locked in, and I’ll make sure to bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, Gus — I appreciate it, and I’ll keep the afternoon open.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — let’s go through it now and make sure everything’s ready for 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — bring your list over and we’ll go through it together now so you’re all set for 10.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — I’ve got my list right here, and I’m ready to go through it now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Right, it’s still not confirmed yet — I’ll let you know as soon as I have the exact day and time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, please do — I’ll wait for the exact day and time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the exact day and time as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday at 4 at the community center and help with the donations.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam — that’s the new spot and time. Thanks for being there Sunday at the community center and helping with the donations!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Tess — happy to help and I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’m telling everyone it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’m making sure everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center — thanks for the reminder. I’ll set a few things out if I find more.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’d be great, Noah — I’ll keep an eye out for anything you set out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll set them by soon if I find a few more things. Thanks for keeping an eye out, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo—send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll take care of what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list ready and I’m sending it over now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll skim it and grab what’s needed. Thanks, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara. Just make sure folks know it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll make sure everyone knows it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara. Appreciate you helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — that kind of help will make Sunday at the community center feel easy and welcoming for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and help keep it easy and welcoming for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That means a lot, Sam — thank you. I’ll keep everything organized on my end, and together we’ll make Sunday smooth for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Dane — I’ll keep the repair supplies organized for you. See you a little later.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll be there a little later to help sort through it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll have everything ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No problem at all — just wanted you to know it’s now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for letting me know, Tess. Sunday at the community center works much better.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Glad to hear it, Uli — I’ll keep it low-key and pass it along if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, Noah — Sunday at the community center is all set. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’ve got it now. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — thanks, Noah. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep sharing the repair drive plan around the block and pass along any updates as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep the repair drive plan moving around the block and let folks know as soon as there’s anything new.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can send a little after lunch on Sunday at the community center. Please keep my name out of it, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. How much can you put in, and when can you send it over quietly?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do a small amount after lunch on Sunday, quietly. Please keep my name out of it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll meet you Sunday at the community center and help with the donations first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Rey—see you Sunday at the community center. We’ll get the donations sorted first and then tackle the repair list together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, Rosa — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and ready to sort the donations first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course, Ira — thanks for keeping an eye out. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the final day and time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Jules — thanks for keeping me posted. I’ll check in when I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — I’ll keep the tools ready and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send the repair details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana — I’ll be ready when your repair details come in.
